top_signals.title: Nvidia hires law firm Wachtell Lipton to lead Jensen Huang affair probe
top_signals.summary: On Sunday, Huang admitted to having an affair with a woman who has been connected to Chinese intelligence by reports in The New York Times and Financial Times.

top_signals.title: SEC Fines, Cases Plunge in Trump-Era ‘Return to Basics’
top_signals.summary: Enforcement cases brought by the top Wall Street watchdog dropped about 25% in the first full fiscal year of the Trump-era Securities and Exchange Commission, the agency reported Tuesday.
